description: Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency - Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 5 of 2019 (The world Anti-Doping Code)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It publishes the official prohibited list of substances and methods in sports, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements under statutory instruments. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
